    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/599547518/v0.29.0</id>

    <title>v0.29.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h1>v0.29.0</h1>
<h2>Highlights</h2>
<p>This release features 594 commits from 277 contributors (91 new)!</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Model Runner V2 is now the default for all models</strong> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5209436023" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53183" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53183/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53183">#53183</a>), completing the rollout that began with pooling models (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4859338343" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48290" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48290/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48290">#48290</a>). MRV2 also gained CUDA graph memory profiling for KV cache auto-sizing (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5217002273" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53306" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53306/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53306">#53306</a>), batch-sharded sampling that cuts per-step logits memory by 1/TP (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5023038565" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/50465" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50465/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50465">#50465</a>), prompt embeds (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4468165522" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/42963" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42963/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42963">#42963</a>), <code>extract_hidden_states</code> speculation (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4976435154" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/49811" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49811/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49811">#49811</a>), padded FULL cudagraph dispatch for uniform decode under spec decode (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5224268841" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53407" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53407/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53407">#53407</a>), and DP-sync skipping before EAGLE/MTP draft prefill (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5243116045" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53694" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53694/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53694">#53694</a>). MRV1 remains in use for a few ROCm models and features MRV2 does not yet support.</li>
<li><strong>New models</strong>: Hy4-preview, Tencent's 770B/49B-active MoE with Gated DeepSeek Sparse Attention and native MTP (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5275259831" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/54160" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54160/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54160">#54160</a>); Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with BF16/FP8/NVFP4 and MTP (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5257259389" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53896" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53896/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53896">#53896</a>); GraniteSWA and GraniteMoeSWA (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5179178405" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52706" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52706/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52706">#52706</a>); NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 with MTP (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5191749387" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52929" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52929/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52929">#52929</a>, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5204637894" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53121" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53121/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53121">#53121</a>); Kimi K3 NVFP4 checkpoints (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5205567349" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53132" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53132/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53132">#53132</a>).</li>
<li><strong>Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek V4 performance</strong>: fused MXFP4 top-k finalization in the K3 latent tail (about 5% E2E latency, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5206732861" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53152" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53152/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53152">#53152</a>), K3 Mamba metadata preparation in one Triton launch (6.6-7.6x kernel speedup, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5155366912" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52388" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52388/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52388">#52388</a>), tuned Hopper low-latency GEMM (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5270636056" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/54088" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54088/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54088">#54088</a>) now also dispatched on SM100 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5231554402" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53534" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53534/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53534">#53534</a>) and used for <code>eh_proj</code> (12.9-25.2% kernel speedup, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5260560316" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53942" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53942/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53942">#53942</a>), GEMM-RS extended to GEMM-AR (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5200092730" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53053" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53053/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53053">#53053</a>), MLA gate merged into the QKV-A projection (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5265157591" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/54015" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54015/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54015">#54015</a>), K3 DCP with DSpark (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5143408851" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52188" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52188/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52188">#52188</a>) and DCP partial prefix cache hits (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5024902326" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/50493" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50493/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50493">#50493</a>); DeepSeek V4 shared experts fused into MegaMoE (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5199333771" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53040" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53040/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53040">#53040</a>), adaptive top-k width re-landed (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5185770562" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52823" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52823/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52823">#52823</a>), a native SwiGLU clamp kernel for Humming MoE (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5242692210" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53685" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53685/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53685">#53685</a>), and an opt-in FlashInfer <code>moe_ep</code> expert backend (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4961919843" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/49636" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49636/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49636">#49636</a>).</li>
<li><strong>Speculative decoding</strong>: per-request acceptance stats in OpenAI API responses via <code>--per-request-spec-decode-metrics</code> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4908287242" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48915" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48915/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48915">#48915</a>), adaptive verification extended to logprobs (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5147428527" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52242" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52242/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52242">#52242</a>), SM100 sparse MLA for GLM-5.2 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5183188300" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52783" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52783/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52783">#52783</a>) and DeepSeek V4 on SM90 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5183962079" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52795" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52795/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52795">#52795</a>), Qwen3-Omni DSpark drafts (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5167704960" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/52560" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52560/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52560">#52560</a>), PLaMo3 EAGLE-3/DFlash (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5280514396" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/54239" format (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5250815518" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/53797" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53797/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53797">#53797</a>).</li>
<li><strong>RL weight sync</strong>: a new <code>sharded_rdt</code> P2P backend where each worker pulls only its TP/EP slice over NIXL or Ray Direct Transport (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" <h2><g-emoji class="g-emoji" alias="warning">⚠️</g-emoji> Model Runner V1 Deprecation</h2>
<p>Now that Model Runner V2 is used by default, we are considering Model Runner V1 deprecated and are targeting v0.32 for its removal. We do not intend to accept any more MRV1-specific improvements or optimizations.</p>
<p>Some <a href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/47172" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/vllm-project/vllm/issues/47172/hovercard">features</a> are not yet supported in MRV2 but we are planning for these gaps to be closed within the next 2-3 weeks. These include sequence parallelism, dual-batch overlap, elastic expert parallellism, custom logits processors and certain speculative decoding methods. For now, vLLM will still fall back to use MRV1 if any of these features are configured.</p>
